title: U.S. EPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) - Resource Conservation and Recovery Act

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_facilities or get_facility_info query, return a comma separated value (CSV) file of the facilities found.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Download Data Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services download [PARAMS] output p pretty print qcolumns qid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Validates query search parameters and returns query identifier.  Use the responseset parameter to set the page size
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Facility Search Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services facilities [PARAMS] 1 1lat 1lon 2 2lat 2lon 4 80cnt act addr agoo c callback cifdi cmps co ct decouple des dwd ejscreen fa fac fcv fea feaa feay fips fn fntype frs huc ico icoo icos idt iea ieaa ieay impw lat law limit long maplist med ncs ncv oct olr output over owop p pd pen pfead pfeat pid pidall pityp pm psncq qcolumns qiv qs queryset radius reg responseset sa section sfs sic st stdist summarylist tablelist trep tribedist tribeid tribename usmex violt violy wbd ysl ysla ysly zip [SCHEMA] 1 data facilities map output rcr results

operations.description: Returns either an array of Facilities or an array of Clusters that meet the specified search criteria.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Facility Enhanced Search Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services facility info [PARAMS] 1 2 4 80cnt act addr agoo callback cifdi cmps co ct decouple des dwd ejscreen fa fac fcv fea feaa feay fips fn fntype frs huc ico icoo icos idt iea ieaa ieay impw lat law limit long med ncs ncv oct olr output over owop p pd pen pfead pfeat pid pidall pityp pm pretty print psncq qcolumns qiv qs queryset radius reg responseset sa section sfs sic st stdist summarylist trep tribedist tribeid tribename usmex violt violy wbd xmax xmin ymax ymin ysl ysla ysly zip [SCHEMA] 0 2 cluster data facilities output qp rcr results

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_facilities or get_facility_info query, return GeoJSON of the facilities found.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) GeoJSON Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services geojson [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output p pretty print qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 5 feature geo properties rcr

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a clustered get_facility_info query, download cluster facility information as either a CSV or GEOJSON file.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Info Clusters Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services info clusters [PARAMS] output p pretty print qid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The purpose of the GET_MAP service is to display facility coordinates and facility clusters related to a get_facilities facility query. Currently, the maximum number of coordinates returned is 500. GET_MAP performs automatic clustering at the state, county, and zip code levels to maximize the number of coordinates returned.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Map Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services map [PARAMS] 1 2 c callback id lat long output p qid tablelist [SCHEMA] 3 data map output rcr

operations.description: GET_QID is passed with a query ID corresponding to a previously run get_facilities query. It then returns a Facility object containing all matching facilities. The main purpose of GET_QID is for large querysets that contain multiple pages (responsesets) of output. GET_QID allows for pagination and for the selection and sorting of columns.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Paginated Results Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services qid [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output pageno qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 1 4 facilities rcr results

operations.description: Returns the JSON Object Name and ColumnId for usage with the qcolumns parameter for get_qid, get_facility_info and other service endpoints.
operations.summary: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) Metadata Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] rcra rest services metadata [PARAMS] callback output [SCHEMA] 1 2 met
